messages:
olivia_csm: Heads up — CrescentPay renewal looks at-risk. 30d active API calls down ~42% vs prior 30d, and there's a 10-seat drop in DAUs. Procurement handed off to a new lead last week and they mentioned a competitor POC (NovaServe). Need quick triage and a go-forward before the renewal thread heats up.

marta_cs: :wave: thanks for flagging. can you paste the usage snapshot and any notes from last call? i'll pull enablement attendance and champion activity.

olivia_csm: pulling analytics snapshot below. also FYI procurement asked about SSO docs — one of their admins said a SAML cert is expiring soon.

analytics-bot: Auto-report — CrescentPay (last 30d):
```
total_api_calls: 18,200  # prior 30d: 31,200
new_users: +3  # prior period: -12
active_seats: 86  -> 96  (10 seat loss)
top_endpoints_decline: /generate (-55%), /embed (-38%)
avg_latency: +12%
```

devon_se: I checked infra logs — saw intermittent 502s from their IP range on 2025-11-18 14:12-14:18 UTC. snippet: ```[2025-11-18T14:13:02Z] ERROR 502 gateway_timeout x-req-id=abc123 client_ip=52.14.77.9``` Could be an integration retry loop or a brief eu-west outage.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-20251118-01: Brief eu-west partial outage 2025-11-18 14:10-14:20 UTC, auto-mitigated. Details: https://status.redwood/INC-20251118-01

sachin_pm: Do we know what NovaServe is promising? if it's purely cost-based (lower per-token), procurement will listen. Recommend offering a 3-week pilot extension with usage credits + a dedicated enablement session for their dev champion. i'll draft pilot terms and pricing fallback.

marta_cs: Action items: olivia confirm SSO cert expiry + admin contact; devon validate whether the 502s were server-side or client; sachin draft pilot terms; i'll prepare a short playbook + 1-pager case studies for similar customers. can we do a 30m procurement + dev champion sync tomorrow 10:00am PT?

olivia_csm: Confirmed: admin is j.morris@crescentpay.com, SAML cert expiry 2025-12-02. Demo earlier this week had low attendance (only 2 devs). 10:00am PT tomorrow works for me. Assigning: devon -> investigate logs & mitigation; marta -> playbook + one-pager; sachin -> pilot terms + credits language. i'll ping procurement and get meeting invite out.

devon_se: on it. quick mitigation note: we can temporarily raise their client burst limit and enable prefix KV-caching on their main route to reduce token usage and retry pressure. i'll prepare a short config diff to propose in the meeting. :thumbsup:

marta_cs: :eyes: i'll include a slide showing estimated token savings from caching/batching vs a simple cost comparison with NovaServe. also prepping Qs for procurement around their evaluation criteria and success metrics.

olivia_csm: thanks team. adding meeting invite now and cc'ing j.morris. if we fix the 502 and deliver a focused enablement, usage should recover pre-renewal. :rocket:
